endpoints.summary: Integration route with intentional path mismatch
endpoints.description: Expected contract specifies valid upstream health integration. Intentional mismatch: client calls nonexistent route /api/v1/nonexistent-service resulting in 404/502.

responses.description: Upstream route not found (404 forwarded as 502 Bad Gateway)

endpoints.summary: Health status probe integration with method mismatch
endpoints.description: Expected contract specifies HTTP method GET for health verification. Intentional mismatch: client integration and endpoint use POST causing 405 Method Not Allowed.

responses.description: Upstream method not allowed (405 forwarded as 502 Bad Gateway)

endpoints.summary:
Broken API 2 (Incorrect HTTP Method):
Calls upstream POST /api/v1/health. The backend health endpoint only supports GET.
The upstream backend returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed.
This endpoint catches the upstream failure and returns HTTP 502 with diagnostic details.
endpoints.description:

endpoints.summary: Project creation integration with schema drift
endpoints.description: Expected contract requires CreateProjectRequest with mandatory field 'name'. Intentional mismatch: client sends invalid keys without 'name', causing 400 Bad Request.

responses.description: Upstream payload validation failed (400 forwarded as 502 Bad Gateway)
